title: 【Event Report】TU Darmstadt & RIKEN-AIP Joint Workshop（October 6, 2026, Darmstadt, Germany）
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: On October 6, 2026, the RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project (RIKEN AIP) and the Technische Universität Darmstadt (TU Darmstadt) co-hosted “TU Darmstadt & RIKEN-AIP Joint Workshop.” Following opening remarks by Director Masashi Sugiyama from RIKEN AIP and Professor Iryna Gurevych from TU Darmstadt, seven researchers from Japan and Germany presented their latest research findings. The workshop was followed by a keynote lecture delivered by Director Sugiyama. Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
